record_type_quote: This study is a replication of Theodori et al.’s (2009) research on public perception of desalinated produced water from oil and gas field operations. The data used in this paper were collected in twelve Texas counties.

targets.authors: Theodori, Gene L., Brooklynn J. Wynveen, William E. Fox, and David B. Burnett.
targets.title: Public Perception of Desalinated Water from Oil and Gas Field Operations: Data from Texas
targets.evidence_quote: In the present paper we replicate Theodori et al.’s (2009) analyses.
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, the results of this investigation paralleled Theodori et al.’s (2009) findings.
